3558-5006-8170-8249.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-5006-8170-8249.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2131-2173-4574-5315--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2131-2173-4574-5315--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

955-4770-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

34-141-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-5231.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {R}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2105-4885-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

728-4535--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

2073-5330-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-5330-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Atog by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1778-3661-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3661-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1809-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Returned Pastcaller and exiling Ephemerate.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-5330-6972.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1409-2895-3147-6664.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3147-6664.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2018-5147-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have flying.
2018-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with a flying counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1805-1978-3301.description:
Animate Pyramid of the Pantheon using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-3558-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

431-2557-4772-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-4772-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2178-6773-6798.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
2178-6773-6798.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2105-3204-4364-5223.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-4364-5223.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2281-5686-5756.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Havi.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

225-1170-3389-5334-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-3389-5334-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4730-5640-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
4730-5640-5917.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Sparring Mummy.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

603-2511-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-2511-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

791-1605-3693-5934.notablePrerequisites:
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-1605-3693-5934.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2743-2750-4483.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-2750-4483.description:
Activate Memnarch's first ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Biovisionary to become an artifact.
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1049-2292-2440-4871.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{W}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable, or an additional {R}, {W} or {B} if you haven't cast Jirina from the command zone this game
1049-2292-2440-4871.description:
Cast Jirina from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Jirina trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token for each time you've cast Jirina from the command zone this game.
When the Human Soldiers enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Human and Soldier you control.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining Mana Echoes trigger created in steps 2 and 4.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Jirina and a Human Soldier.
Choose to return Jirina to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Jirina and the Human Soldier die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, if you control a Human Soldier, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a Human Soldier.
If you sacrificed a Human Soldier this way, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from steps 7 and 10, causing you to scry 1 three times.
Activate up to three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding any combination of {R}, {W} and {B}.
Repeat.

586-1770-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

851-1575-1651-4659.description:
Activate Nuka-Cola Vending Machine by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping Nuka-Cola Vending Machine.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Foods.

813-2292-2701-3047.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Scholar of the Ages.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages dies, it triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Feign Death and Dark Ritual to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

3900-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Daru Healer, adding {W}.
When Daru Healer dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Daru Healer from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Daru Healer's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

3088-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
Xenic Poltergeist does not have summoning sickness.
3088-4740.description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 3.

140-2100-4050-4258.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 4 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
140-2100-4050-4258.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R} due to Rowan's ability, targeting any applicable target.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {R}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1643-2034-2073-3459.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Clown Car enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Clown Car, adding {C}{C}.
Clown Car dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.
